_note: Machine-readable spec for the reusable AI illustration pack. `core` rows already have images and their original prompts live in manifest.json. Rows with a `subject` are waiting for artwork. Keywords match the narration sentence (3 points) and the issue headline (1 point). Avoid words that appear in almost every script (보도, 정부, 정책, 발표).
